| TunerStudio label | Setting | Units | Range | Help (as TunerStudio shows it) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Short term fuel trim | `fuelClosedLoopCorrectionEnabled` | choice |  | Enables lambda sensor closed loop feedback for fuelling. |
| Minimum CLT | `stft_minClt` | {bitStringValue(unitsLabels | {useMetricOnInterface ? 0 : 17.77777} … {useMetricOnInterface ? -20 : -4} | Minimum coolant temperature before closed loop operation is allowed. |
| After DFCO delay | `noFuelTrimAfterDfcoTime` | sec | 0 … 10 | Pause closed loop fueling after deceleration fuel cut occurs. Set this to a little longer than however long is required for normal fueling behavior to resume after fuel cut. |
| Detect Tuning and Suspend | `isTuningDetectorEnabled` | choice |  |  |
| Minimum AFR for learning | `stft_minAfr` | afr | 10 … 20 | Below this AFR, correction is paused |
| Maximum AFR for learning | `stft_maxAfr` | afr | 10 … 20 | Above this AFR, correction is paused |
| Adjustment deadband | `stft_deadband` | % | 0 … 3 | When close to correct AFR, pause correction. This can improve stability by not changing the adjustment if the error is extremely small, but is not required. |
| Ignore error magnitude | `stftIgnoreErrorMagnitude` | choice |  | If enabled, adjust at a constant rate instead of a rate proportional to the current lambda error. This mode may be easier to tune, and more tolerant of sensor noise. |
| Idle region RPM | `stft_maxIdleRegionRpm` | RPM | 0 … 12000 | Below this RPM, the idle region is active, idle+300 would be a good value |
| Overrun region load | `stft_maxOverrunLoad` | load | 0 … 250 | Below this engine load, the overrun region is active When tuning by MAP the units are kPa/psi, e.g. 30 would mean 30kPa. When tuning TPS, 30 would be 30% |
| Power region load | `stft_minPowerLoad` | load | 0 … 250 | Above this engine load, the power region is active When tuning by MAP the units are kPa/psi |
| Time const | `stft_cellCfgs1_timeConstant` | sec | 0.1 … 100 | Commonly referred as Integral gain. Time constant for correction while in this cell: this sets responsiveness of the closed loop correction. A value of 5.0 means it will try to make most of the correction within 5 seconds, and a value of 1.0 will try to correct within 1 second. Lower values makes the correction more sensitive, higher values slow the correction down. |
| Max add | `stft_cellCfgs1_maxAdd` | % | 0 … 25 | Maximum % that the short term fuel trim can add |
| Max remove | `stft_cellCfgs1_maxRemove` | % | 0 … 25 | Maximum % that the short term fuel trim can remove |
